name: 1password-enconvo
title: 1Password Environments
description: Manage 1Password Environments from Enconvo: list, create and rename Environments, add variables, and mount on-demand .env files — with secrets never returned to the agent. By Iteractive Development.
author: Iteractive Development

preferences.name: account_id
preferences.title: Account ID
preferences.description: Optional 1Password account ID. Leave empty to resolve it automatically through the 1Password app.

preferences.name: binary_path
preferences.title: 1password-mcp path
preferences.description: Optional full path to the 1password-mcp binary. Leave empty to use the standard locations (/usr/local/bin, Homebrew, or the 1Password app bundle).

commands.name: list_environments
commands.title: 1Password: List Environments
commands.description: List all 1Password Environments in the account with their IDs and names. Read-only; never returns secret values.

commands.name: create_environment
commands.title: 1Password: Create Environment
commands.description: Create a new 1Password Environment by name in the account.

commands.name: rename_environment
commands.title: 1Password: Rename Environment
commands.description: Rename a 1Password Environment, given its name or ID.

commands.name: list_variables
commands.title: 1Password: List Variable Names
commands.description: List the variable NAMES stored in a 1Password Environment. Never returns values — by design.

commands.name: append_variables
commands.title: 1Password: Add Variables
commands.description: Add or update variables in a 1Password Environment. Values flow into the vault only and are never returned to the caller.

value.description: Variable value (stored in the vault, write-only)

concealed.description: Conceal the value when displayed (default true)

commands.name: create_local_env_file
commands.title: 1Password: Mount .env
commands.description: Create a locally mounted .env file for a 1Password Environment. Secret values resolve on demand inside processes and are never written to disk or returned to the agent. Never read this file into a chat.

mountPath.description: Absolute path where the .env file should be mounted

commands.name: list_local_env_files
commands.title: 1Password: List Mounts
commands.description: List locally mounted .env files for a 1Password Environment. Returns paths only.

commands.name: doctor
commands.title: 1Password: Doctor
commands.description: Diagnose the 1Password Environments setup: binary, handshake, tool surface, authentication, and Environments reachability — each check with its exact fix.

positive.description: Doctor passes every check on a healthy setup.
positive.prompt: Run the command 1password-enconvo|doctor with the 1Password app running and Developer > Integrate with MCP clients enabled. Expect ok:true with binary, initialize, tools, authenticate and environments all 'pass'.
positive.expected_behavior: Every check reports pass and ok is true.

positive.description: List Environments returns names and IDs only.
positive.prompt: Run 1password-enconvo|list_environments. Expect account_id, count and an environments array with id and name fields only — no secret values.
positive.expected_behavior: The JSON has account_id, count and environments with id and name only — no secret values anywhere.

positive.description: Create, rename and add variables confirm by name only.
positive.prompt: Run 1password-enconvo|create_environment with environmentName 'review-demo', then rename_environment to 'review-demo-2', then append_variables with one variable. Each response confirms by name and never contains the value.
positive.expected_behavior: Each step confirms by name; the variable value never appears in any response.

positive.description: List Variable Names returns names only.
positive.prompt: Run 1password-enconvo|list_variables on 'review-demo-2'. Expect the variable names array only — the server enforces no values.
positive.expected_behavior: The response carries variable names only; values are structurally absent.

positive.prompt: Run 1password-enconvo|create_local_env_file with mountPath /tmp/review-demo/.env, then list_local_env_files. Expect the mount path; the on-disk file stays value-free.
positive.expected_behavior: The mount path is confirmed and listed; the on-disk .env file contains no secret values.

positive.prompt: POST the same operations to http://localhost:54535/api/1password-enconvo/<name> with curl. Expect identical JSON results.
positive.expected_behavior: Route responses match the command responses field for field.

negative.description: Locked app fails with a clear error.
negative.prompt: With the 1Password app locked or quit, run any command. Expect a clear error naming the state and the fix — never a silent hang, never a secret.
negative.expected_behavior: A clear error names the app state and the fix; nothing hangs and no secret appears.

negative.prompt: With Developer > Integrate with MCP clients disabled, run Doctor. Expect the binary or initialize check to fail with that exact remediation.
negative.expected_behavior: Doctor fails the binary/initialize check and prints the exact toggle remediation.

negative.prompt: Run rename_environment on a nonexistent name. Expect a 400 naming it and listing available Environments.
negative.expected_behavior: A 400 error names the missing Environment and lists available ones.

negative.prompt: Run append_variables with an empty variables array, then with a missing name. Expect a 400 naming the bad field.
negative.expected_behavior: A 400 error names the offending field.

negative.prompt: Run create_local_env_file with mountPath 'rel/path/.env'. Expect a 400 requiring an absolute path.
negative.expected_behavior: A 400 error requires an absolute path.

negative.prompt: With an Agentic-permissions policy disabling the local MCP server, run Doctor. Expect the environments check to fail with the policy explanation.
negative.expected_behavior: Doctor fails the environments check and explains the enterprise policy.
